interface.description: Ally/human addresses PM only. PM owns the GO turn and posts the four-line receipt under webhook username pm unless a charter delegate fires.

specialists.description: Specialists are lane charters + tool/path limits — not a parallel chat room or agents agreeing with each other.

visible_room.description: One Discord channel, one webhook, different username= per persona — visibility for Ally, not multi-agent coherence.

swarm.description: Multi-persona collab rounds (trio brainstorm/critique/converge, collab_ab, ops A/B trio arm). Agent↔agent agreement chains — not the interface.

ops_ab_harness.description: RAZ-335 live ops solo/trio A/B — Ally mothball 2026-09-29; session cap disarmed.

collab_ab.description: Offline mock A/B harness in chip.collab_ab.run_ab — includes trio arm.

delegate.description: delegate: only when another lane's charter owns the files. Relay runs one follow-up chip room per hop; specialist posts receipt on the same #chip-dev webhook with username=<persona>, then stops — no ping-pong threads between agents.

pm_orchestrator.description: After a specialist delegate receipt, relay may run one pm orchestrator tick (not a delegate hop). Separate from swarm unlock.
